notes.title: Hint System & Visual Improvements | v1.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

So far, we've had a lot of fun watching your playthroughs and received many useful pieces of feedback as well. One of the suggestions we often see is regarding improved in-game guidance. We want to try and provide clearer hints that you guys can use to keep the game flow as smooth and enjoyable as possible. So, we added a new feature where you can enable a hint system during the memory association process.

We also improved the button mash UI clarity during the [spoiler]calming down[/spoiler] sequence.

[h2]Undying Flower v1.2.0[/h2]

[b]🆕 New Features:[/b]
[*] Memory association hint system

[b]🛠 Improvements:[/b]
[*] Button mash UI clarity
[*] Fixed weird white lines in main menu opening book scene
[*] Fixed Nala's legs occasionally disappearing during the first person view
[*] Improved certain character's eyes animation in one of the ending scenes

Let us know what you think about the new hint system!
Also feel free to let us know if you encounter any other issues. We have a [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3180670/discussions/0/592897436326842696/"]pinned post[/url] in our game discussion page for bug reporting and [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3180670/discussions/0/598527550147273520/"]troubleshooting page[/url] that you may want to check out. You can also report a bug through our [url="https://discord.gg/mx3sTfwsan"]Discord[/url] server.

[hr][/hr][h2]🌟How You Can Support Us[/h2]
[olist]
[*] If you buy the game, please consider leaving an [b]honest review[/b] on Steam!
Reviews have a massive impact on indie games. We'd love to hear about your experience, feedback, and reactions.
[*] Share them on social media and spread the word to your family and closest friends. Every bit of share or casual discussion helps more players discover our game through word of mouth.
[*] Join our community in [url="https://discord.gg/mx3sTfwsan"]Discord[/url] to get to know each other and perhaps to discover our next journey.
[*] Follow us on our [url="https://twitter.com/calcatz"]Twitter[/url] and other socials, and be sure to follow the game to stay up to date with our future news!
[/olist]

notes.title: Bug Fixes | v1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Thank you so much to everyone who’s played, left a review, streamed the game, or told a friend. Your support means a lot to us. 💖

We've heard some of our players encountered issues during gameplay, and we've just pushed a small update to address some of the issues.

[h2]Undying Flower v1.0.1[/h2]

[b]🛠 Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Prevented auto-save during the journal tutorial to fix uncontrollable player bug when user reload the save data from the main menu
[*] Disabled move between memory points during journal tutorial
[*] Fixed Nala stands on a wrong position when changing Memory Point at a certain moment
[*] Fixed Nala visibility & positioning that blocks a text when simulating memory manipulation
[*] Fixed a text bug in one of the diorama when simulating memory manipulation
[*] Fixed where certain cutscenes run improperly during the second playthrough
[*] Fixed Comet in Mummyland song from being repeated
[*] Fixed wrong dialogue in near ending (Nala dialogue shown as grandpa dialogue)
[*] Fixed a misspelling in the credits
[*] Fixed a minor font issue in Option's resolutions text
[*] Fixed where some tutorial texts turned black during the second playthrough
[/list]
[b]🛠 Quality Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved good ending music quality
[*] Minor rendering optimization
[*] Improved reflection quality on high settings, and improved reflection performance on low settings
[/list]
[b]🛠 Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] In a very low performance device, black screen can appear after interacting with a Memory Fragment. In this case, the game must be reloaded from the main menu.
[*] In a very rare instance the water reflection on certain scene flickered and emitted very bright light. To temporarily fix it, change the screen resolution to any other resolution. Once it's resolved, you can switch back to your original resolution.
[/list]
Feel free to let us know if you encounter any issue. We have a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3180670/discussions/0/592897436326842696/]pinned post[/url] in our game discussion page for bug reporting and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3180670/discussions/0/598527550147273520/]troubleshooting page[/url] that you may want to check out. You can also report a bug through our [url=https://discord.gg/mx3sTfwsan]Discord[/url] server.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]🏷️Launch Discount![/h2]
As part of the celebration, Undying Flower is [b]10% off for 11 days[/b]! It's the perfect time to be the one among the firsts to experience Nala's journey in the Memory World!

[h2]🌟How You Can Support Us[/h2]
As a small indie team, every bit of support means a lot to us. Here is how you can help us:

notes.title: Where We Are & What's Next
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Since teaming up with our new publisher, [url=https://www.indie.io/]indie.io[/url], we've been able to push development further and improve the game with better standards. We are getting closer to delivering our full game, and we're happy to share our game progress, as well as sharing how we are going to move ahead.

[h2]Engine Upgrade[/h2]
One of our biggest technical steps forward has been upgrading our game engine to Unity 2022. This resulted in several optimizations, better stability, better visuals, and most importantly: compatibility improvements, which may unlock more potentials for further upgrades in the future. It took some effort, but it was worth it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216987/1231afbbf6208e363d05bcff1b3109e6a3e3001b.png[/img]

[h2]Accessibility Improvements[/h2]
Key rebindings will be available in full version release! We wanted to give you guys more flexibility in customizing controls to fit your preferences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216987/d1fbaf2d526e3e4c2fb2d29673a2e2093dfb8664.png[/img]
We've heard your feedback as well regarding the UI navigation controls clarity, so we made a change to make them more intuitive and easier to navigate.

[h2]Ultrawide Support[/h2]
We've also received some reports regarding the ultrawide issue, as it was not officially supported. Now, you can enjoy Undying Flower in ultrawide monitors, even in the demo version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216987/f3953f5d0c1f58ae26e74c7432403aa9fa298391.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216987/4f564dd6b251b89e4568f2f7ce9c92860fa751c6.png[/img]

[h2]Improved English[/h2]
Now that we got everything tied-up, we went for a full proofreading of our scripts. With the help of your feedback and our publisher, we have finally refined all of our English in-game texts!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Moving Ahead[/h2]
While there's still work to be done, it's definitely getting very close. Looking ahead, not only do we want to keep refining our game, but we also want to share more about the creative vision behind the game. We want to share the ideas and philosophies that shape Undying Flower, giving you a deeper context of what drives our design choices, in hope to build a stronger connection with you guys.

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for your support! Don't forget to wishlist the game, and share!
